title: Raw conversation is provenance below the vignettes; we pull out fragments and export only the key bits (2026-11-05)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
So, there is rarely much value in every utterance as a record. 
What we want is a version of the Vignette process we already have. 
The raw conversation shows provenance. They sit at a level below the vignettes. We pull out important fragments as vignettes... and then abstract records from that. 

Just like the other files we may be basing our essays on, when we export an essay, we probably don't want to include the full source materials - just the key bits of text that we are building from
